content:
需要 Apotheosis

此模組專為模組包設計

This mod is for ModPack

此模組會移除 Apotheosis 的某些配方

This mod removes some recipes of Apotheosis

 

將被移除的配方列表

List of recipes to be removed

  • Hellshelf
  • Prismatic CobWeb
  • Tome of Helmets
  • Tome of Chestplates
  • Tome of Legplates
  • Tome of Boots
  • Tome of Weaponry
  • Tome of the Archers
  • Tome of the Miners
  • Tome of the Fishers
  • Tome of the Others
  • Tome of Scrapping
  • Blazing Hellshelf
  • Glowing Hellshelf
  • Seashelf
  • Crystalline Seashelf
  • Heart-Forged Seashelf
  • Pearlescent Endshelf
  • Draconic Endshelf
  • Beeshelf
  • Melonshelf

在版本 1.1.0 中，您可以使用設定檔來更改 Apotheosis 藥水的材料。您可以更改以下藥水的材料（原始藥水和添加物品）：

In version 1.1.0, you can change the ingredients of Apotheosis potions using the config. You can change the ingredients (original potion and added items) of the following potions:

  • Potion of Resistance
  • Potion of Sundering
  • Potion of Absorption
  • Potion of Haste
  • Potion of Fatigue
  • Potion of Wither
  • Potion of Ancient Knowledge
  • Potion of Ancient Knowledge (Level II)
  • Potion of Luck
  • Potion of Healing Boost
  • Potion of Healing Reduction
  • Potion of Levitation
  • Potion of Flying
  • Potion of Flying (Long)
  • Potion of Flying (Extra Long)

如果您將添加物品的 ID 寫成 null，則可以刪除該配方。

You can delete the recipe by writing null instead of the added item's Id.

 

此外，在設定檔中您也可以刪除附魔金蘋果的配方，並禁用幸運兔腳的掉落。

You can also remove the recipe for enchanted golden apples and disable the drop of lucky rabbit's feet in the config.

 

修改設定檔後請重新啟動 Minecraft

If you change the configuration, restart Minecraft.
